name: spawning-draws
comment: The random-ticks-stone-platform world with natural spawning on (difficulty 0: setAllowedMobSpawns(false, true), creatures and water creatures). There is no grass and no water, and every spot with a normal cube below lies within 24 blocks of the player, so SpawnerAnimals.performSpawning never reaches a mob constructor; it still draws from World.rand for every eligible chunk (biome pick, spawn point, 72 jitter draws for air) and loads the chunks it probes. Pins those draws.
